from AlgorithmImports import *
from datetime import timedelta, time


class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        # Set backtest parameters
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone("America/New_York")

        # Subscribe to SPY Equity (Minute, Raw Data)
        equity = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute, dataNormalizationMode=DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy = equity.Symbol

        # Subscribe to SPY Option Universe (Minute Resolution)
        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol
        # Filter for calls, strikes around underlying, and expiration window >= 7 days
        option.SetFilter(lambda u: u.CallsOnly().Strikes(-15, 15).Expiration(7, 60))

        # Setup 5-minute consolidator aligned to NY clock boundaries (09:30-09:35, etc.)
        consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(timedelta(minutes=5))
        consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy, consolidator)

        # Indicators for 5-minute SPY closing prices
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        # State tracking for crossover detection
        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        # Position and Order Tracking
        self.held_contract_symbol = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.is_order_pending = False
        self.no_entry_date = None

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar):
        # Update indicators with completed 5-minute TradeBar
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not (self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady):
            self.prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
            self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value
            return

        curr_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        curr_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        # Check for bullish moving-average crossover
        is_crossover = (
            self.prev_fast is not None 
            and self.prev_slow is not None 
            and self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow 
            and curr_fast > curr_slow
        )

        # Update previous indicator values
        self.prev_fast = curr_fast
        self.prev_slow = curr_slow

        if not is_crossover:
            return

        # Time filter: Only open position when 5-minute bar ends between 09:45 and 14:30 NY time, inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        if not (time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30)):
            return

        # Do not trade if replacement is forbidden for today or if holding/pending position
        if self.Time.date() == self.no_entry_date:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {self.Time}: Expiration processing already occurred today.")
            return

        if self.is_order_pending or self.held_contract_symbol is not None or self.Portfolio.Invested:
            return

        # Evaluate entry signal
        self.TryExecuteEntry()

    def TryExecuteEntry(self):
        # Inspect option chain delivered in current Slice
        if not self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry at {self.Time}: Option chain unavailable in current Slice.")
            return

        chain = self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
        current_date = self.Time.date()

        # Filter calls with DTE >= 7 calendar days
        valid_calls = [
            c for c in chain 
            if c.Right == OptionRight.Call and (c.Expiry.date() - current_date).days >= 7
        ]

        if not valid_calls:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry at {self.Time}: No Call contracts meeting the DTE >= 7 requirement.")
            return

        # Select nearest expiration date >= 7 calendar days
        min_expiry = min(c.Expiry.date() for c in valid_calls)
        target_calls = [c for c in valid_calls if c.Expiry.date() == min_expiry]

        # Select ATM Call (closest strike to current SPY price)
        underlying_price = self.Securities[self.spy].Price
        if underlying_price <= 0:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry at {self.Time}: Invalid underlying SPY price.")
            return

        selected_contract = min(target_calls, key=lambda c: abs(c.Strike - underlying_price))

        # Submit market order for 1 contract
        self.is_order_pending = True
        self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        self.Debug(f"Submitted Entry Order for 1 contract: {selected_contract.Symbol} at {self.Time}")

    def OnData(self, slice):
        # Handle unexpected SPY equity position (from exercise/assignment) immediately
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy].Invested:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy)
            self.Debug(f"Liquidated unexpected SPY equity position at {self.Time}")

        # Exit evaluation for held option contract
        if self.held_contract_symbol is None:
            return

        if not self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Invested and not self.is_order_pending:
            self.held_contract_symbol = None
            self.entry_price = None
            return

        expiry_date = self.held_contract_symbol.ID.Date.date()
        today = self.Time.date()

        # Expiration processing fallback: Liquidate immediately if position held into expiration day
        if today >= expiry_date:
            self.Liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)
            self.no_entry_date = today
            self.Debug(f"Liquidated contract at expiration date ({today}): {self.held_contract_symbol}")
            self.held_contract_symbol = None
            self.entry_price = None
            return

        # Time stop: 15:45 NY time on trading day immediately preceding expiration date
        prev_trading_day = self.GetPreviousTradingDay(expiry_date)
        if today == prev_trading_day and self.Time.time() >= time(15, 45):
            self.Liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)
            self.Debug(f"Scheduled time stop exit at 15:45 before expiry ({today}): {self.held_contract_symbol}")
            self.held_contract_symbol = None
            self.entry_price = None
            return

        # Profit target check (50% profit based on midpoint of strictly positive bid and ask)
        if self.entry_price is not None and self.entry_price > 0:
            quote = slice.QuoteBars.get(self.held_contract_symbol)
            if quote is not None and quote.Bid is not None and quote.Ask is not None:
                bid = quote.Bid.Close
                ask = quote.Ask.Close
                if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                    midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                    if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:
                        self.Liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)
                        self.Transactions.CancelOpenOrders(self.held_contract_symbol)
                        self.Debug(
                            f"Profit target (50%) reached at {self.Time}. Mid: {midpoint:.2f}, "
                            f"Entry: {self.entry_price:.2f}. Liquidated {self.held_contract_symbol}"
                        )
                        self.held_contract_symbol = None
                        self.entry_price = None

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent):
        if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
            order = self.Transactions.GetOrderById(orderEvent.OrderId)
            if order.Symbol.SecurityType == SecurityType.Option:
                if order.Direction == OrderDirection.Buy:
                    self.entry_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                    self.held_contract_symbol = orderEvent.Symbol
                    self.is_order_pending = False
                    self.Debug(f"Entry Filled: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {orderEvent.FillPrice}")
                elif order.Direction == OrderDirection.Sell:
                    self.Debug(f"Exit Filled: {orderEvent.Symbol} at {orderEvent.FillPrice}")
                    self.held_contract_symbol = None
                    self.entry_price = None
                    self.is_order_pending = False
        elif orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid, OrderStatus.Rejected]:
            self.is_order_pending = False
            self.Debug(f"Order {orderEvent.OrderId} was {orderEvent.Status}")

    def OnAssignment(self, assignmentEvent):
        self.Debug(f"Option Assignment Event received at {self.Time}: {assignmentEvent}")
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy].Invested:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy)
            self.Debug(f"Immediately liquidated SPY equity position from assignment at {self.Time}")

    def GetPreviousTradingDay(self, date_val):
        d = date_val - timedelta(days=1)
        while d.weekday() >= 5 or not self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDay(d).IsMarketOpen:
            d -= timedelta(days=1)
        return d

from AlgorithmImports import *
from datetime import datetime, time, timedelta


class BullishOptionCrossover(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        # Backtest parameters
        self.set_start_date(2023, 4, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2026, 6, 30)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        self.set_time_zone("America/New_York")

        # Subscribe to SPY equity with minute resolution and RAW price normalization
        self.spy_equity = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE, DataNormalizationMode.RAW)
        self.spy_symbol = self.spy_equity.symbol

        # Subscribe to SPY options at minute resolution
        self.option = self.add_option("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE)
        self.option.set_filter(lambda u: u.calls_only().strikes(-20, 20).expiration(7, 60))

        # Consolidate 5-minute TradeBars aligned to New York clock boundaries
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(timedelta(minutes=5))
        self.consolidator.data_consolidated += self.on_five_minute_bar
        self.subscription_manager.add_consolidator(self.spy_symbol, self.consolidator)

        # Fast (5-bar) and Slow (20-bar) Simple Moving Averages of 5-minute closing prices
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        # Tracking state for moving average crossover detection
        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None
        self.prev_ready = False

        # Strategy position and order state tracking
        self.held_contract_symbol = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.is_entry_order_pending = False
        self.pending_entry_symbol = None
        self.last_expiration_liquidated_date = None

    def on_five_minute_bar(self, sender: object, bar: TradeBar) -> None:
        # Update moving averages with completed 5-minute bar closing price
        self.fast_sma.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)
        self.slow_sma.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)

        both_ready = self.fast_sma.is_ready and self.slow_sma.is_ready

        if not both_ready:
            self.prev_fast = self.fast_sma.current.value
            self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.current.value
            self.prev_ready = False
            return

        curr_fast = self.fast_sma.current.value
        curr_slow = self.slow_sma.current.value

        # Test bullish crossover condition (Fast <= Slow on preceding bar and Fast > Slow on current bar)
        is_crossover = False
        if self.prev_ready and self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None:
            if (self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow) and (curr_fast > curr_slow):
                is_crossover = True

        # Save current indicator values for the next bar comparison
        self.prev_fast = curr_fast
        self.prev_slow = curr_slow
        self.prev_ready = True

        if not is_crossover:
            return

        # Entry window check: bar ends from 09:45 through 14:30 NY time, inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.end_time.time()
        if not (time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30)):
            return

        # Ensure no existing option holdings or pending entry orders exist
        if self.portfolio.invested or self.is_entry_order_pending or self.held_contract_symbol is not None:
            return

        # Do not open replacement position if an expiration liquidation occurred today
        if self.last_expiration_liquidated_date == self.time.date():
            self.debug(f"{self.time}: Crossover ignored - Option expiration liquidation occurred today.")
            return

        # Attempt to inspect chain and submit entry order
        self.try_enter_position()

    def try_enter_position(self) -> None:
        slice_data = self.current_slice
        if slice_data is None or not slice_data.option_chains:
            self.debug(f"{self.time}: Entry skipped - No option chains delivered in current slice.")
            return

        chain = slice_data.option_chains.get(self.option.symbol)
        if chain is None:
            for sym, ch in slice_data.option_chains.items():
                if sym.underlying == self.spy_symbol:
                    chain = ch
                    break

        if not chain:
            self.debug(f"{self.time}: Entry skipped - SPY option chain not found.")
            return

        current_date = self.time.date()

        # Filter call contracts only
        call_contracts = [c for c in chain if c.right == OptionRight.CALL]
        if not call_contracts:
            self.debug(f"{self.time}: Entry skipped - No call contracts in chain.")
            return

        # Filter expirations at least 7 calendar days after current algorithm date
        valid_contracts = [c for c in call_contracts if (c.expiry.date() - current_date).days >= 7]
        if not valid_contracts:
            self.debug(f"{self.time}: Entry skipped - No call contract with DTE >= 7 calendar days.")
            return

        # Find the nearest eligible expiration date
        min_expiry = min(c.expiry.date() for c in valid_contracts)
        target_calls = [c for c in valid_contracts if c.expiry.date() == min_expiry]
        if not target_calls:
            self.debug(f"{self.time}: Entry skipped - No call contracts found for expiry {min_expiry}.")
            return

        underlying_price = self.securities[self.spy_symbol].price
        if underlying_price <= 0:
            self.debug(f"{self.time}: Entry skipped - Invalid underlying price.")
            return

        # Select ATM call contract (strike closest to underlying price)
        selected_contract = min(target_calls, key=lambda c: abs(c.strike - underlying_price))

        # Submit market order for 1 contract
        ticket = self.market_order(selected_contract.symbol, 1)
        if ticket.status != OrderStatus.INVALID:
            self.is_entry_order_pending = True
            self.pending_entry_symbol = selected_contract.symbol
            self.debug(f"{self.time}: Submitted entry market order for {selected_contract.symbol} (Expiry: {min_expiry}, Strike: ${selected_contract.strike:.2f}).")
        else:
            self.debug(f"{self.time}: Entry market order submission rejected.")

    def on_order_event(self, order_event: OrderEvent) -> None:
        if order_event.status == OrderStatus.FILLED:
            # Capture actual filled entry price from order event
            if self.is_entry_order_pending and order_event.symbol == self.pending_entry_symbol:
                self.entry_price = order_event.fill_price
                self.held_contract_symbol = order_event.symbol
                self.is_entry_order_pending = False
                self.pending_entry_symbol = None
                self.debug(f"{self.time}: ENTRY FILLED - Symbol: {self.held_contract_symbol}, Fill Price: ${self.entry_price:.2f}")

            # Reset strategy state when position exit fills
            elif self.held_contract_symbol and order_event.symbol == self.held_contract_symbol:
                if not self.portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].invested:
                    self.debug(f"{self.time}: EXIT FILLED - Symbol: {order_event.symbol}, Fill Price: ${order_event.fill_price:.2f}")
                    self.held_contract_symbol = None
                    self.entry_price = None
                    self.is_entry_order_pending = False
                    self.pending_entry_symbol = None

    def on_data(self, slice: Slice) -> None:
        # Immediately liquidate any unintended SPY equity position resulting from exercise or assignment
        if self.portfolio[self.spy_symbol].invested:
            self.debug(f"{self.time}: SPY equity position detected from exercise/assignment. Liquidating immediately.")
            self.liquidate(self.spy_symbol)

        # Safety check: Liquidate any option position held on or after its expiration date
        for symbol, holding in self.portfolio.items():
            if symbol.security_type == SecurityType.OPTION and holding.invested:
                if self.time.date() >= symbol.id.date.date():
                    self.debug(f"{self.time}: Option {symbol} held on/after expiration date {symbol.id.date.date()}. Liquidating immediately.")
                    self.liquidate(symbol)
                    self.last_expiration_liquidated_date = self.time.date()
                    if symbol == self.held_contract_symbol:
                        self.held_contract_symbol = None
                        self.entry_price = None
                        self.is_entry_order_pending = False
                        self.pending_entry_symbol = None

        # Exit evaluation on each minute slice for active strategy position
        if self.held_contract_symbol and self.entry_price is not None and not self.is_entry_order_pending:
            if not self.portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].invested:
                return

            # Profit target check: Midpoint of strictly positive bid/ask >= 1.50 * filled entry price
            if slice.quote_bars.contains_key(self.held_contract_symbol):
                qb = slice.quote_bars[self.held_contract_symbol]
                if qb.bid is not None and qb.ask is not None:
                    bid = qb.bid.close
                    ask = qb.ask.close
                    if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                        midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                        if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:
                            self.debug(f"{self.time}: Profit target reached (Mid: ${midpoint:.2f}, Entry: ${self.entry_price:.2f}). Liquidating option.")
                            self.liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)
                            return

            # Scheduled time stop: 15:45 NY time on trading day immediately preceding contract expiration date
            expiry_date = self.held_contract_symbol.id.date.date()

        elif symbol in self.Securities:
            sec = self.Securities[symbol]
            return (sec.BidPrice, sec.AskPrice)

        if today >= exp_date:

        ]

            # If today is the last trading day before expiration date
            if idx + 1 < len(trading_days):
                return trading_days[idx + 1] >= exp_date
            return True
        return False

class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        # Set backtest parameters
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone(TimeZones.NewYork)

        # Subscribe to SPY equity with minute resolution and raw data normalization
        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute, Market.USA, fillDataForward=False, leverage=1.0)
        self.spy.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy_symbol = self.spy.Symbol

        # Subscribe to SPY options with minute resolution
        self.option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = self.option.Symbol
        self.option.SetFilter(self.OptionFilter)

        # 5-minute consolidator aligned to clock boundaries
        consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(timedelta(minutes=5))
        consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy_symbol, consolidator)

        # Indicators: 5-bar and 20-bar Simple Moving Averages of 5-min closes
        self.fast = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        # Rolling state for crossover detection
        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None
        self.curr_fast = None
        self.curr_slow = None

        # Position tracking state
        self.entry_fill_price = None
        self.held_contract = None
        self.entry_ticket = None
        self.current_date = None
        self.no_entry_today = False

    def OptionFilter(self, universe):
        # Broad filter for calls with expirations between 7 and 60 days, near ATM
        return universe.CallsOnly().Expiration(7, 60).Strikes(-10, 10)

    def OnFiveMinBar(self, sender, bar):
        # Update SMA indicators with actual 5-minute bar closes
        self.fast.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not (self.fast.IsReady and self.slow.IsReady):
            return

        c_fast = self.fast.Current.Value
        c_slow = self.slow.Current.Value

        # Test crossover if previous completed bar state exists
        if self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None:
            # Bullish crossover: Fast <= Slow on preceding bar, Fast > Slow on current bar
            is_bullish_crossover = (self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow) and (c_fast > c_slow)

            if is_bullish_crossover:
                bar_time = bar.EndTime.time()
                # Entry window: Bar ends from 09:45 through 14:30 inclusive
                if time(9, 45) <= bar_time <= time(14, 30):
                    self.TryEntry(bar.EndTime)

        self.prev_fast = c_fast
        self.prev_slow = c_slow

    def TryEntry(self, signal_time):
        if self.no_entry_today:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {signal_time}: Entry blocked for today after expiration exit.")
            return

        # Check if an entry order is currently open
        open_orders = self.Transactions.GetOpenOrders()
        if any(o.Symbol.SecurityType == SecurityType.Option for o in open_orders):
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {signal_time}: Open option order exists.")
            return

        # Check if an option position is currently held
        if any(p.Value.Invested and p.Value.Symbol.SecurityType == SecurityType.Option for p in self.Portfolio):
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {signal_time}: Option position currently held.")
            return

        # Inspect option chain delivered in the current Slice
        chain = self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains.GetValue(self.option_symbol)
        if chain is None or len(chain) == 0:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {signal_time}: No option chain delivered in current slice.")
            return

        current_date = self.Time.date()

        # Consider only call contracts with expiration >= 7 calendar days after current date
        eligible_contracts = [
            c for c in chain
            if c.Right == OptionRight.Call and (c.Expiry.date() - current_date).days >= 7
        ]

        if not eligible_contracts:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {signal_time}: No call contracts with expiration >= 7 calendar days.")
            return

        # Choose the nearest expiration date satisfying >= 7 days
        min_expiry = min(c.Expiry.date() for c in eligible_contracts)
        contracts_at_expiry = [c for c in eligible_contracts if c.Expiry.date() == min_expiry]

        # Select ATM call contract (closest strike to SPY price)
        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Price
        if spy_price <= 0:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {signal_time}: Invalid SPY underlying price.")
            return

        selected_contract = min(contracts_at_expiry, key=lambda c: abs(c.Strike - spy_price))

        # Submit market order for exactly 1 contract
        self.entry_ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        self.held_contract = selected_contract.Symbol
        self.entry_fill_price = None  # Will be set in OnOrderEvent
        self.Debug(f"Entry order submitted for {selected_contract.Symbol} at {self.Time}")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent):
        # Record filled entry price from order fill event
        if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
            if self.entry_ticket is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_ticket.OrderId:
                self.entry_fill_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.Debug(f"Entry order filled for {orderEvent.Symbol} at price {self.entry_fill_price:.2f}")

        # Immediate cleanup if assignment/exercise creates a SPY equity position
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Invested:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy_symbol)
            self.Debug(f"Unexpected SPY equity position created by exercise/assignment. Liquidated immediately at {self.Time}.")

    def OnData(self, slice):
        # Daily state reset
        if self.Time.date() != self.current_date:
            self.current_date = self.Time.date()
            self.no_entry_today = False

        # Safety check for SPY equity position
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Invested:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy_symbol)
            self.Debug(f"Liquidated unexpected SPY equity holding at {self.Time}.")

        # Evaluate exits on each minute slice for held option

    ) -> bool:

            day = self.trading_calendar.get_trading_day(check_date)
            if day.is_open:

        """Returns True if current_date is the trading day immediately preceding expiry_date."""
        if current_date >= expiry_date:

        for day in trading_days:
            if day.IsOpen:
                return False

        return True

        self.fast_sma.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)
        self.slow_sma.update(bar.end_time, bar.close)

        if self.slow_sma.is_ready:

        if self.portfolio[self.spy_symbol].invested:

        if self.held_contract_symbol is not None:

                self.entry_price = None
                return

                    )
                    self.liquidate_held_option("Time Stop 15:45 Pre-Expiry")
                    return

                # Profit Target (50%): Check midpoint of bid and ask in current slice
                if slice_data.quote_bars.contains_key(self.held_contract_symbol):

                        ask = qb.ask.close

                            if self.entry_price and midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:

                                    f"{self.time}: Profit target reached. Midpoint {midpoint:.2f} >= 1.50 * Fill Price {self.entry_price:.2f}"
                                )
                                self.liquidate_held_option("Profit Target 50%")
                                return

    def on_order_event(self, order_event):
        """Tracks entry order fills and failures."""
        if self.entry_ticket and order_event.order_id == self.entry_ticket.order_id:
            if order_event.status == OrderStatus.FILLED:
                self.entry_price = order_event.fill_price
                self.held_contract_symbol = order_event.symbol
                self.entry_order_open = False
                self.debug(
                    f"{self.time}: Entry order filled for {order_event.symbol} at price {self.entry_price}"
                )
            elif order_event.status in [OrderStatus.CANCELED, OrderStatus.INVALID, OrderStatus.REJECTED]:
                self.entry_order_open = False
                self.entry_ticket = None
                self.debug(f"{self.time}: Entry order failed/canceled with status {order_event.status}")

    def liquidate_held_option(self, tag):
        """Liquidates the held option contract and cancels any open orders for it."""
        if self.held_contract_symbol is not None:
            self.transactions.cancel_open_orders(self.held_contract_symbol)
            self.liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol, tag=tag)
            self.held_contract_symbol = None
            self.entry_price = None

    def is_option_invested_or_pending(self):
        """Returns True if an option is currently held or an entry order is pending."""
        if self.entry_order_open:
            return True
        if self.held_contract_symbol is not None and self.portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].invested:
            return True
        for kvp in self.portfolio:
            if kvp.key.security_type == SecurityType.OPTION and kvp.value.invested:
                return True
        return False

    def get_preceding_trading_day(self, expiry_date):
        """Finds the open trading day immediately preceding the given expiry date."""
        days = self.trading_calendar.get_trading_days(
            expiry_date - timedelta(days=10), expiry_date - timedelta(days=1)
        )
        open_days = [d.date.date() for d in days if d.is_open]
        if open_days:
            return open_days[-1]
        return expiry_date - timedelta(days=1)

            self.Liquidate(self.held_contract_symbol)

        if not open_days or open_days[0] >= expiry_date:

            self.Debug(f"[{self.Time}] SPY Equity Order Event Filled. Liquidating SPY equity immediately.")
            self.Liquidate(self.spy.Symbol)

    def OnAssignment(self, assignmentEvent: AssignmentEvent):

        if self.Portfolio[self.spy.Symbol].Invested:

        if not self.fast_sma.is_ready or not self.slow_sma.is_ready:
            self.fast_prev = self.fast_sma.current.value
            self.slow_prev = self.slow_sma.current.value
            return

        fast_curr = self.fast_sma.current.value
        slow_curr = self.slow_sma.current.value

        # Test bullish crossover: fast <= slow previously AND fast > slow currently
        is_crossover = (
            self.fast_prev is not None
            and self.fast_prev <= self.slow_prev
            and fast_curr > slow_curr
        )

        # Store current values for next comparison
        self.fast_prev = fast_curr
        self.slow_prev = slow_curr

        if not is_crossover:
            return

        bar_time = bar.end_time.time()
        if not (time(9, 45) <= bar_time <= time(14, 30)):

            bar_time = bar.EndTime.time()

        if self.Time.hour == 15 and self.Time.minute == 45:

                if len(future_trading_days) == 0 or (len(future_trading_days) == 1 and future_trading_days[0] == expiry_date):
                    self.LiquidatePosition("Time stop reached (15:45 NY on trading day preceding expiration)")

            self.no_new_entries_today = curr_date

    def LiquidatePosition(self, reason):
        if self.held_contract_symbol is not None:
            qty = self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Quantity
            if qty != 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -qty)
                self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Exiting option position ({reason}). Order submitted for {-qty} contracts.")
                open_orders = self.Transactions.GetOpenOrders(self.held_contract_symbol)
                for order in open_orders:
                    self.Transactions.CancelOrder(order.Id)

        """
        if current_date >= expiry_date:

from AlgorithmImports import *
from datetime import datetime, time, timedelta


class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        # Set backtest parameters
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)

        # Set New York Timezone
        self.SetTimeZone("America/New_York")

        # Subscribe to SPY Equity with raw data normalization
        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute, Market.USA, True, 1.0, False)
        self.spy.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy_symbol = self.spy.Symbol

        # Subscribe to SPY Option universe
        self.option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = self.option.Symbol
        self.option.SetFilter(self.OptionFilter)

        # Consolidate 5-minute SPY TradeBars aligned to market open (09:30-09:35 -> ends at 09:35)
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5))
        self.consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy_symbol, self.consolidator)

        # Moving Averages on 5-minute closing prices
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        # State Variables
        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        self.held_contract_symbol = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.entry_order_id = None
        self.pending_entry = False
        self.last_expiration_liquidation_date = None

    def OptionFilter(self, universe):
        """
        Filter option chain to include calls with expiration at least 7 calendar days out.
        """
        return universe.CallsOnly().Strikes(-10, 10).Expiration(TimeSpan.FromDays(7), TimeSpan.FromDays(60))

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar):
        """
        Consolidator callback for 5-minute bars. Evaluates indicators and crossover entry signals.
        """
        # Update simple moving averages with the 5-minute bar close
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not (self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady):
            return

        # Check for bullish crossover
        crossover = False
        if self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None:
            crossover = (self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow) and (self.fast_sma.Current.Value > self.slow_sma.Current.Value)

        # Update previous values for the next completed bar
        self.prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        if not crossover:
            return

        # Validate entry time window: Crossover bar must end from 09:45 through 14:30 NY time, inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        if not (time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30)):
            return

        # Do not enter if a position is currently open or an entry order is pending
        if self.pending_entry or self.held_contract_symbol is not None:
            return

        # Do not enter if position was liquidated today due to expiration processing
        if self.Time.date() == self.last_expiration_liquidation_date:
            return

        # Inspect current option chain slice
        slice = self.CurrentSlice
        if slice is None or not slice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {self.Time}: No option chain in current Slice.")
            return

        chain = slice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
        current_date = self.Time.date()

        # Select nearest expiration >= 7 calendar days from current algorithm date
        valid_expirations = set()
        for contract in chain:
            days_to_exp = (contract.Expiry.date() - current_date).days
            if days_to_exp >= 7:
                valid_expirations.add(contract.Expiry.date())

        if not valid_expirations:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {self.Time}: No expiration >= 7 calendar days found.")
            return

        target_expiration = min(valid_expirations)

        # Filter calls for the selected expiration date
        calls = [c for c in chain if c.Expiry.date() == target_expiration and c.Right == OptionRight.Call]
        if not calls:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {self.Time}: No call contracts found for expiration {target_expiration}.")
            return

        # Select call contract with strike closest to current SPY price
        underlying_price = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Price
        if underlying_price <= 0:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {self.Time}: Invalid underlying SPY price ({underlying_price}).")
            return

        selected_contract = min(calls, key=lambda c: abs(c.Strike - underlying_price))

        # Subscribe directly to contract to ensure continuous minute quotes
        self.AddOptionContract(selected_contract.Symbol, Resolution.Minute)

        # Submit market order for exactly 1 contract
        self.pending_entry = True
        self.held_contract_symbol = selected_contract.Symbol
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        self.entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId
        self.Debug(f"Bullish Crossover at {self.Time}. Submitted Entry Market Order for {selected_contract.Symbol} (Strike: {selected_contract.Strike}, Expiry: {target_expiration}).")

    def OnData(self, slice: Slice):
        """
        Evaluates exits on each minute Slice and cleans up unexpected equity holdings.
        """
        # 1. Immediately liquidate any SPY equity position resulting from option exercise/assignment
        spy_holding = self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol]
        if spy_holding.Invested:
            qty = spy_holding.Quantity
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy_symbol, -qty)
            self.Debug(f"Unexpected SPY equity position detected ({qty} shares). Liquidated immediately.")

        # 2. Check option holding state
        if self.held_contract_symbol is None:
            return

        holding = self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol]

        # Reset state if holding was closed or expired
        if not holding.Invested and not self.pending_entry:
            self.held_contract_symbol = None
            self.entry_price = None
            self.entry_order_id = None
            return

        exp_date = self.held_contract_symbol.ID.Date.date()
        current_date = self.Time.date()

        # Exit Rule A: Forced liquidation if position remains on or after expiration date
        if current_date >= exp_date:
            if holding.Invested:
                self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -holding.Quantity)
                self.last_expiration_liquidation_date = current_date
                self.Debug(f"Expiration cleanup exit: Liquidated {self.held_contract_symbol} on/after expiration date {current_date}.")
            self.held_contract_symbol = None
            self.entry_price = None
            self.entry_order_id = None
            return

        # Exit Rule B: Time stop at 15:45 NY time on the trading day immediately preceding contract expiration
        if self.Time.time() >= time(15, 45) and self.IsPrecedingTradingDay(current_date, exp_date):
            if holding.Invested:
                self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -holding.Quantity)
                self.Debug(f"Time stop exit: Liquidated {self.held_contract_symbol} at 15:45 NY time on day before expiration.")
                self.held_contract_symbol = None
                self.entry_price = None
                self.entry_order_id = None
            return

        # Exit Rule C: 50% Profit Target based on strictly positive bid/ask midpoint
        if holding.Invested and self.entry_price is not None and self.entry_price > 0:
            bid, ask = 0.0, 0.0

            if slice.Quotes.ContainsKey(self.held_contract_symbol):
                q = slice.Quotes[self.held_contract_symbol]
                if q.Bid is not None and q.Ask is not None:
                    bid = q.Bid.Price
                    ask = q.Ask.Price
            elif slice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
                chain = slice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
                for c in chain:
                    if c.Symbol == self.held_contract_symbol:
                        bid = c.BidPrice
                        ask = c.AskPrice
                        break

            if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -holding.Quantity)
                    self.Debug(f"Profit Target exit: Midpoint {midpoint:.2f} >= 1.50 * Entry Price ({self.entry_price:.2f}). Liquidated {self.held_contract_symbol}.")
                    self.held_contract_symbol = None
                    self.entry_price = None
                    self.entry_order_id = None

    def IsPrecedingTradingDay(self, current_date, exp_date):
        """
        Returns True if current_date is the open market trading day immediately preceding exp_date.
        """
        if current_date >= exp_date:
            return False

        start_date = current_date + timedelta(days=1)
        end_date = exp_date - timedelta(days=1)

        if start_date > end_date:
            return True

        trading_days = self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDays(start_date, end_date)
        open_days = [day for day in trading_days if day.IsMarketOpen]
        return len(open_days) == 0

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent: OrderEvent):
        """
        Record filled entry price from order event execution.
        """
        if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
            if self.entry_order_id is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_order_id:
                self.entry_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.pending_entry = False
                self.Debug(f"Entry order filled: {orderEvent.Symbol} at price {self.entry_price:.2f}.")

        elif orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid, OrderStatus.Rejected]:
            if self.entry_order_id is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_order_id:
                self.pending_entry = False
                self.entry_order_id = None
                self.held_contract_symbol = None
                self.entry_price = None
                self.Debug(f"Entry order {orderEvent.OrderId} was {orderEvent.Status}.")

class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        # Set backtest parameters
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)

        # Set New York Timezone
        self.SetTimeZone("America/New_York")

        # Subscribe to SPY Equity with raw data normalization
        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute, Market.USA, True, 1.0, False)
        self.spy.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy_symbol = self.spy.Symbol

        # Subscribe to SPY Option universe
        self.option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = self.option.Symbol
        self.option.SetFilter(self.OptionFilter)

        # Consolidate 5-minute SPY TradeBars aligned to market open (09:30-09:35 -> ends at 09:35)
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5))
        self.consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy_symbol, self.consolidator)

        # Moving Averages on 5-minute closing prices
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        # State Variables
        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        self.held_contract_symbol = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.entry_order_id = None
        self.pending_entry = False
        self.last_expiration_liquidation_date = None

    def OptionFilter(self, universe):
        """
        Filter option chain to include calls with expiration at least 7 calendar days out.
        """
        return universe.CallsOnly().Strikes(-10, 10).Expiration(TimeSpan.FromDays(7), TimeSpan.FromDays(60))

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar):
        """
        Consolidator callback for 5-minute bars. Evaluates indicators and crossover entry signals.
        """
        # Update simple moving averages with the 5-minute bar close
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not (self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady):
            return

        # Check for bullish crossover
        crossover = False
        if self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None:
            crossover = (self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow) and (self.fast_sma.Current.Value > self.slow_sma.Current.Value)

        # Update previous values for the next completed bar
        self.prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        if not crossover:
            return

        # Validate entry time window: Crossover bar must end from 09:45 through 14:30 NY time, inclusive
        bar_end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        if not (time(9, 45) <= bar_end_time <= time(14, 30)):
            return

        # Do not enter if a position is currently open or an entry order is pending
        if self.pending_entry or self.held_contract_symbol is not None:
            return

        # Do not enter if position was liquidated today due to expiration processing
        if self.Time.date() == self.last_expiration_liquidation_date:
            return

        # Inspect current option chain slice
        slice = self.CurrentSlice
        if slice is None or not slice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {self.Time}: No option chain in current Slice.")
            return

        chain = slice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
        current_date = self.Time.date()

        # Select nearest expiration >= 7 calendar days from current algorithm date
        valid_expirations = set()
        for contract in chain:
            days_to_exp = (contract.Expiry.date() - current_date).days
            if days_to_exp >= 7:
                valid_expirations.add(contract.Expiry.date())

        if not valid_expirations:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {self.Time}: No expiration >= 7 calendar days found.")
            return

        target_expiration = min(valid_expirations)

        # Filter calls for the selected expiration date
        calls = [c for c in chain if c.Expiry.date() == target_expiration and c.Right == OptionRight.Call]
        if not calls:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {self.Time}: No call contracts found for expiration {target_expiration}.")
            return

        # Select call contract with strike closest to current SPY price
        underlying_price = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Price
        if underlying_price <= 0:
            self.Debug(f"Skipped signal at {self.Time}: Invalid underlying SPY price ({underlying_price}).")
            return

        selected_contract = min(calls, key=lambda c: abs(c.Strike - underlying_price))

        # Subscribe directly to contract to ensure continuous minute quotes
        self.AddOptionContract(selected_contract.Symbol, Resolution.Minute)

        # Submit market order for exactly 1 contract
        self.pending_entry = True
        self.held_contract_symbol = selected_contract.Symbol
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        self.entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId
        self.Debug(f"Bullish Crossover at {self.Time}. Submitted Entry Market Order for {selected_contract.Symbol} (Strike: {selected_contract.Strike}, Expiry: {target_expiration}).")

    def OnData(self, slice: Slice):
        """
        Evaluates exits on each minute Slice and cleans up unexpected equity holdings.
        """
        # 1. Immediately liquidate any SPY equity position resulting from option exercise/assignment
        spy_holding = self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol]
        if spy_holding.Invested:
            qty = spy_holding.Quantity
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy_symbol, -qty)
            self.Debug(f"Unexpected SPY equity position detected ({qty} shares). Liquidated immediately.")

        # 2. Check option holding state
        if self.held_contract_symbol is None:
            return

        holding = self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol]

        # Reset state if holding was closed or expired
        if not holding.Invested and not self.pending_entry:
            self.held_contract_symbol = None
            self.entry_price = None
            self.entry_order_id = None
            return

        exp_date = self.held_contract_symbol.ID.Date.date()
        current_date = self.Time.date()

        # Exit Rule A: Forced liquidation if position remains on or after expiration date
        if current_date >= exp_date:
            if holding.Invested:
                self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -holding.Quantity)
                self.last_expiration_liquidation_date = current_date
                self.Debug(f"Expiration cleanup exit: Liquidated {self.held_contract_symbol} on/after expiration date {current_date}.")
            self.held_contract_symbol = None
            self.entry_price = None
            self.entry_order_id = None
            return

        # Exit Rule B: Time stop at 15:45 NY time on the trading day immediately preceding contract expiration
        if self.Time.time() >= time(15, 45) and self.IsPrecedingTradingDay(current_date, exp_date):
            if holding.Invested:
                self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -holding.Quantity)
                self.Debug(f"Time stop exit: Liquidated {self.held_contract_symbol} at 15:45 NY time on day before expiration.")
                self.held_contract_symbol = None
                self.entry_price = None
                self.entry_order_id = None
            return

        # Exit Rule C: 50% Profit Target based on strictly positive bid/ask midpoint
        if holding.Invested and self.entry_price is not None and self.entry_price > 0:
            bid, ask = 0.0, 0.0

            if slice.Quotes.ContainsKey(self.held_contract_symbol):
                q = slice.Quotes[self.held_contract_symbol]
                if q.Bid is not None and q.Ask is not None:
                    bid = q.Bid.Price
                    ask = q.Ask.Price
            elif slice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
                chain = slice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
                for c in chain:
                    if c.Symbol == self.held_contract_symbol:
                        bid = c.BidPrice
                        ask = c.AskPrice
                        break

            if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -holding.Quantity)
                    self.Debug(f"Profit Target exit: Midpoint {midpoint:.2f} >= 1.50 * Entry Price ({self.entry_price:.2f}). Liquidated {self.held_contract_symbol}.")
                    self.held_contract_symbol = None
                    self.entry_price = None
                    self.entry_order_id = None

    def IsPrecedingTradingDay(self, current_date, exp_date):
        """
        Returns True if current_date is the open market trading day immediately preceding exp_date.
        """
        if current_date >= exp_date:
            return False

        start_date = current_date + timedelta(days=1)
        end_date = exp_date - timedelta(days=1)

        if start_date > end_date:
            return True

        trading_days = self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDays(start_date, end_date)
        open_days = [day for day in trading_days if day.IsMarketOpen]
        return len(open_days) == 0

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent: OrderEvent):
        """
        Record filled entry price from order event execution.
        """
        if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
            if self.entry_order_id is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_order_id:
                self.entry_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.pending_entry = False
                self.Debug(f"Entry order filled: {orderEvent.Symbol} at price {self.entry_price:.2f}.")

        elif orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid, OrderStatus.Rejected]:
            if self.entry_order_id is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_order_id:
                self.pending_entry = False
                self.entry_order_id = None
                self.held_contract_symbol = None
                self.entry_price = None
                self.Debug(f"Entry order {orderEvent.OrderId} was {orderEvent.Status}.")

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, time


class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        # Backtest Parameters
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone("America/New_York")

        # Add SPY Equity with Minute resolution and Raw price format
        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute, DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy_symbol = self.spy.Symbol

        # Subscribe to SPY Options at Minute resolution
        self.option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = self.option.Symbol
        # Filter universe to Calls with DTE between 7 and 60 days and near ATM strikes
        self.option.SetFilter(lambda u: u.CallsOnly().Expiration(7, 60).Strikes(-15, 15))

        # Consolidator for 5-minute TradeBars aligned to New York clock boundaries
        self.consolidator = TradeBarConsolidator(timedelta(minutes=5))
        self.consolidator.DataConsolidated += self.OnFiveMinuteBar
        self.SubscriptionManager.AddConsolidator(self.spy_symbol, self.consolidator)

        # Moving Averages (5-bar and 20-bar SMAs of 5-minute closing prices)
        self.fast_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)

        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        # Strategy State Variables
        self.entry_signal_pending = False
        self.pending_entry_order_id = None
        self.held_contract = None
        self.entry_price = None

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, sender, bar: TradeBar):
        """
        Consolidates 5-minute SPY bars aligned to NY clock boundaries (first bar ends at 09:35).
        Updates moving averages only with actual consolidated bars.
        """
        self.fast_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not (self.fast_sma.IsReady and self.slow_sma.IsReady):
            self.prev_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
            self.prev_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value
            return

        current_fast = self.fast_sma.Current.Value
        current_slow = self.slow_sma.Current.Value

        # Bullish Crossover: Fast <= Slow on previous bar and Fast > Slow on current bar
        crossover = (self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None and
                     self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow and current_fast > current_slow)

        self.prev_fast = current_fast
        self.prev_slow = current_slow

        if crossover:
            bar_time = bar.EndTime.time()
            # Entry Window: Bar closes between 09:45 and 14:30 NY time inclusive
            if time(9, 45) <= bar_time <= time(14, 30):
                self.entry_signal_pending = True
                self.Debug(f"Bullish Crossover detected at {bar.EndTime}. Signal queued.")

    def OnData(self, slice: Slice):
        """
        Evaluates entry signals and handles position maintenance / exits on every minute Slice.
        """
        # 1. Immediate liquidation of unexpected SPY equity position from exercise/assignment
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Invested:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy_symbol)
            self.Debug("Liquidated unexpected SPY equity position from assignment/exercise.")

        # 2. Process pending entry signal immediately after eligible bar close
        if self.entry_signal_pending:
            self.TryExecuteEntry(slice)

        # 3. Process exits if holding an option contract
        if self.held_contract is not None:
            self.EvaluateExit(slice)

    def TryExecuteEntry(self, slice: Slice):
        """
        Inspects option chain and places market order for 1 contract.
        Signal is evaluated once; if ineligible or missing chain, skipped and not queued.
        """
        self.entry_signal_pending = False

        # Do not submit entry if an option position or pending entry order exists
        if self.held_contract is not None or self.pending_entry_order_id is not None or self.Portfolio.Invested:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: Position already open or order pending.")
            return

        chain = slice.OptionChains.GetValue(self.option_symbol)
        if chain is None or len(chain) == 0:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: No option chain in current Slice.")
            return

        curr_date = self.Time.date()

        # Consider only Call contracts with Expiration >= 7 calendar days
        valid_contracts = [
            c for c in chain
            if c.Right == OptionRight.Call and (c.Expiry.date() - curr_date).days >= 7
        ]

        if not valid_contracts:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: No calls satisfying >= 7 calendar days DTE rule.")
            return

        # Target nearest expiration date among valid contracts
        nearest_expiry = min(c.Expiry.date() for c in valid_contracts)
        target_contracts = [c for c in valid_contracts if c.Expiry.date() == nearest_expiry]

        if not target_contracts:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: No contract at selected expiration.")
            return

        # Select ATM Call (closest strike to SPY price)
        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Price
        if spy_price <= 0:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: Invalid SPY price.")
            return

        selected_contract = min(target_contracts, key=lambda c: abs(c.Strike - spy_price))

        # Submit Market Order for 1 contract immediately
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        if ticket.OrderId > 0:
            self.pending_entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId
            self.Debug(f"Submitted Entry Market Order for {selected_contract.Symbol.Value}")

    def EvaluateExit(self, slice: Slice):
        """
        Evaluates profit target and scheduled time stop on each minute Slice.
        """
        contract_symbol = self.held_contract
        position = self.Portfolio[contract_symbol]

        if not position.Invested:
            self.held_contract = None
            self.entry_price = None
            return

        contract_expiry = contract_symbol.ID.Date.date()

        # Expiration safety check: liquidates if position remains on or after expiration date
        if self.Time.date() >= contract_expiry:
            self.MarketOrder(contract_symbol, -position.Quantity)
            self.Debug(f"Safety Exit: Liquidated contract {contract_symbol.Value} on/after expiration date.")
            self.held_contract = None
            self.entry_price = None
            return

        # Scheduled Time Stop: 15:45 NY time on the trading day immediately preceding contract expiration
        if self.Time.hour == 15 and self.Time.minute == 45:
            if self.IsPrecedingTradingDay(contract_expiry):
                self.MarketOrder(contract_symbol, -position.Quantity)
                self.Debug(f"Time Stop Exit (15:45 day before expiration): Liquidated {contract_symbol.Value}")
                self.held_contract = None
                self.entry_price = None
                return

        # Profit Target: 50% profit (midpoint >= 1.50 * filled entry price)
        if self.entry_price is not None and self.entry_price > 0:
            quote = slice.QuoteBars.get(contract_symbol)
            if quote is not None and quote.Bid is not None and quote.Ask is not None:
                bid = quote.Bid.Close
                ask = quote.Ask.Close
                if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                    midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                    if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:
                        self.MarketOrder(contract_symbol, -position.Quantity)
                        self.Debug(f"Profit Target Exit: Midpoint {midpoint:.2f} >= 1.5x Entry {self.entry_price:.2f}")
                        self.held_contract = None
                        self.entry_price = None

    def IsPrecedingTradingDay(self, expiry_date):
        """
        Returns True if the current algorithm date is the trading day immediately preceding expiry_date.
        """
        curr_date = self.Time.date()
        if curr_date >= expiry_date:
            return False

        next_day = curr_date + timedelta(days=1)
        if next_day >= expiry_date:
            return True

        trading_days = self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDays(next_day, expiry_date - timedelta(days=1))
        valid_between = [d.Date.date() for d in trading_days if d.IsTradingDay]
        return len(valid_between) == 0

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent: OrderEvent):
        """
        Records actual filled entry price from the order fill event.
        """
        if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
            if self.pending_entry_order_id == orderEvent.OrderId:
                self.entry_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.held_contract = orderEvent.Symbol
                self.pending_entry_order_id = None

        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)
        self.SetTimeZone("America/New_York")

        # Subscribe to SPY underlying minute resolution with raw prices and no data forward filling
        spy_equity = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute, Market.USA, fillDataForward=False, leverage=1.0)
        spy_equity.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy = spy_equity.Symbol

        # Subscribe to SPY options universe at minute resolution
        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol
        option.SetFilter(lambda u: u.callsOnly().strikes(-30, 30).expiration(7, 60))

        # 5-minute bar consolidation state
        self.five_min_closes = deque(maxlen=25)
        self.current_5min_target = None
        self.current_5min_bar_close = None

        # Position tracking state
        self.pending_entry_order_id = None
        self.held_contract_symbol = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.last_expiration_liquidated_date = None
        self.current_slice = None

    def OnData(self, slice: Slice):
        self.current_slice = slice

        # 1. Immediately liquidate any unexpected SPY equity position (e.g. from assignment/exercise)
        if self.Portfolio[self.spy].Invested:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity)
            self.Debug("Unexpected SPY equity position detected. Liquidated immediately.")

        # 2. Synchronize portfolio state for held option
        if self.held_contract_symbol is not None:
            if not self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Invested and self.pending_entry_order_id is None:
                self.held_contract_symbol = None
                self.entry_price = None

        # 3. Expiration Safety Net: Never hold an option into/past its expiration date
        if self.held_contract_symbol is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Invested:
            expiry_date = self.held_contract_symbol.ID.Date.date()
            if self.Time.date() >= expiry_date:
                self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Quantity)
                self.last_expiration_liquidated_date = self.Time.date()
                self.Debug(f"Safety net triggered: Liquidated {self.held_contract_symbol} on expiration date {expiry_date}.")
                self.held_contract_symbol = None
                self.entry_price = None
                return

        # 4. Scheduled Time Stop: 15:45 NY time on the trading day immediately preceding expiration
        if self.held_contract_symbol is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Invested:
            if self.Time.hour == 15 and self.Time.minute == 45:
                expiry_date = self.held_contract_symbol.ID.Date.date()
                if self.IsTradingDayBeforeExpiration(self.Time.date(), expiry_date):
                    self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Quantity)
                    self.Debug(f"Scheduled time stop at 15:45 prior to expiration {expiry_date}. Liquidated {self.held_contract_symbol}.")
                    self.held_contract_symbol = None
                    self.entry_price = None
                    return

        # 5. Profit Target Check (50% gain based on positive Bid/Ask midpoint in current Slice)
        if self.held_contract_symbol is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Invested and self.entry_price is not None:
            if slice.QuoteBars.ContainsKey(self.held_contract_symbol):
                qb = slice.QuoteBars[self.held_contract_symbol]
                if qb.Bid is not None and qb.Ask is not None:
                    bid = qb.Bid.Close
                    ask = qb.Ask.Close
                    if bid > 0 and ask > 0:
                        midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
                        if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_price:
                            self.MarketOrder(self.held_contract_symbol, -self.Portfolio[self.held_contract_symbol].Quantity)
                            self.Debug(f"Profit target (50%) reached: Midpoint {midpoint:.2f} >= 1.50 * Entry {self.entry_price:.2f}. Liquidating.")
                            self.held_contract_symbol = None
                            self.entry_price = None

        # 6. Process incoming SPY TradeBars to build 5-minute bars aligned to NY clock boundaries
        if slice.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            bar = slice.Bars[self.spy]
            bar_time = bar.EndTime

            # Regular trading session filter: 09:30 < time <= 16:00
            if time(9, 30) < bar_time.time() <= time(16, 0):
                rem = bar_time.minute % 5
                add_mins = (5 - rem) if rem != 0 else 0
                target_time = (bar_time + timedelta(minutes=add_mins)).replace(second=0, microsecond=0)

                if self.current_5min_target is None:
                    self.current_5min_target = target_time
                    self.current_5min_bar_close = bar.Close
                elif target_time == self.current_5min_target:
                    self.current_5min_bar_close = bar.Close
                else:
                    # Finalize previous bar if we moved past its boundary
                    self.OnFiveMinuteBarClosed(self.current_5min_target, self.current_5min_bar_close)
                    self.current_5min_target = target_time
                    self.current_5min_bar_close = bar.Close

                if bar_time == self.current_5min_target:
                    self.OnFiveMinuteBarClosed(self.current_5min_target, self.current_5min_bar_close)
                    self.current_5min_target = None
                    self.current_5min_bar_close = None

    def OnFiveMinuteBarClosed(self, bar_end_time, close_price):
        self.five_min_closes.append(close_price)

        # Require at least 21 five-minute closes to compute fast(5) and slow(20) SMAs for current and preceding bar
        if len(self.five_min_closes) < 21:
            return

        closes = list(self.five_min_closes)

        # Averages for preceding completed five-minute bar
        prev_20 = closes[-21:-1]
        prev_fast = sum(prev_20[-5:]) / 5.0
        prev_slow = sum(prev_20) / 20.0

        # Averages for current completed five-minute bar
        curr_20 = closes[-20:]
        curr_fast = sum(curr_20[-5:]) / 5.0
        curr_slow = sum(curr_20) / 20.0

        # Check for bullish moving-average crossover
        is_bullish_crossover = (prev_fast <= prev_slow) and (curr_fast > curr_slow)
        if not is_bullish_crossover:
            return

        # Check eligible entry window: bar end time from 09:45 through 14:30 inclusive
        bar_tod = bar_end_time.time()
        if not (time(9, 45) <= bar_tod <= time(14, 30)):
            return

        # Do not enter if a position is held, an order is open, or liquidation occurred today due to expiration
        if self.pending_entry_order_id is not None or self.held_contract_symbol is not None:
            return

        if self.last_expiration_liquidated_date == bar_end_time.date():
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: Option was liquidated at expiration earlier today.")
            return

        # Evaluate entry logic immediately after eligible 5-minute bar closes
        self.TryEnterOptionPosition(bar_end_time)

    def TryEnterOptionPosition(self, bar_end_time):
        slice = self.current_slice
        if slice is None or not slice.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            self.Debug("Skipped signal: No option chain delivered in current slice.")
            return

        chain = slice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
        curr_date = self.Time.date()

        # Filter calls with calendar DTE >= 7
        valid_calls = []
        for contract in chain:
            if contract.Right != OptionRight.Call:
                continue
            dte = (contract.Expiry.date() - curr_date).days
            if dte >= 7:
                valid_calls.append(contract)

        if not valid_calls:
            self.Debug("Skipped signal: No call options found with DTE >= 7 calendar days.")
            return

        # Select nearest expiration
        min_expiry = min(c.Expiry.date() for c in valid_calls)
        expiry_contracts = [c for c in valid_calls if c.Expiry.date() == min_expiry]

        # Select call contract closest to underlying SPY price (select higher strike on tie)
        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy].Price
        if spy_price <= 0:
            self.Debug("Skipped signal: SPY price unavailable or non-positive.")
            return

        selected_contract = min(expiry_contracts, key=lambda c: (abs(c.Strike - spy_price), -c.Strike))

        # Submit market order for 1 contract
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected_contract.Symbol, 1)
        if ticket.Status != OrderStatus.Invalid:
            self.pending_entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId
            self.Debug(f"Entry order submitted: {selected_contract.Symbol}, DTE={(min_expiry - curr_date).days}, Strike={selected_contract.Strike}, SPY={spy_price:.2f}")
        else:
            self.Debug("Skipped signal: Entry market order returned invalid status.")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent: OrderEvent):
        if self.pending_entry_order_id is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.pending_entry_order_id:
            if orderEvent.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.entry_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
                self.held_contract_symbol = orderEvent.Symbol
                self.pending_entry_order_id = None
                self.Debug(f"Entry order FILLED: {orderEvent.Symbol} at price {self.entry_price:.2f}")
            elif orderEvent.Status in [OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid, OrderStatus.Rejected]:
                self.Debug(f"Entry order failed with status: {orderEvent.Status}")
                self.pending_entry_order_id = None

    def IsTradingDayBeforeExpiration(self, current_date, expiry_date):
        if current_date >= expiry_date:
            return False
        trading_days = self.TradingCalendar.GetTradingDays(current_date + timedelta(days=1), expiry_date)
        open_days = [d for d in trading_days if d.IsOpen]
        if not open_days:
            return True
        return all(d.Date.date() >= expiry_date for d in open_days)

class SPYOptionCrossoverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    """
    QuantConnect LEAN Algorithm: SPY Long Call Strategy based on 5-Minute Moving Average Crossover.
    
    Backtest Period: April 1, 2023 - June 30, 2026
    Initial Cash: $100,000
    Time Zone: New York (America/New_York)
    """

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2023, 4, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2026, 6, 30)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        self.set_time_zone("America/New_York")

        # Subscribe to SPY equity data with RAW normalization
